title: Container tracking
summary: See container status, location updates and estimated arrivals beside the purchase order when the tracking integration is enabled.

title: Links on shipments
summary: Keep a tracking page, customer link or document URL with the purchase order it belongs to.

title: Shipment carbon QR codes
summary: Print or scan a QR code to open the shipment’s carbon information.

title: Document search with sources
summary: Find the relevant passage in company documentation and open the section it came from.

title: Terminal visits
summary: Follow each vehicle from arrival to departure and see how long it has been waiting.

title: Transport exceptions
summary: See delays and missing updates, assign someone to follow up and keep a record of how each issue was resolved.

title: Transport carbon reports
summary: Review emissions by shipment, vehicle, customer and period, with the data and calculation method behind each figure.

title: Energy and data savings reports
summary: Add energy and data savings to ESG reports, with the evidence behind the figures.

title: Purchase orders from scans
summary: Extract fields from a scanned purchase order so an operator can review them before saving the draft.

title: Connected company knowledge
summary: Find current, authorized information across company sources, with links back to the original material.
